title: Tabata Spark
description: Intense tabata with squat jumps, tuck jumps, skaters and broad jumps for explosive cardio

exercises.name: Joint rotations
exercises.instructions: Neck, shoulders, wrists, hips, ankles - slow and controlled

exercises.name: Butt kicks
exercises.instructions: Run in place, heels toward the glutes

exercises.name: Side shuffles
exercises.instructions: Fast lateral steps, 3-4 steps each side

exercises.name: Hip 90/90
exercises.instructions: Seated, legs at 90 degrees, pivot from side to side

exercises.name: Squat jumps
exercises.instructions: Explosive squat with a maximum jump, absorb the landing

exercises.name: Tuck jumps
exercises.instructions: Jump bringing knees up to the chest

exercises.name: Skaters
exercises.instructions: Lateral jumps from foot to foot, arms swinging

exercises.name: Broad jumps
exercises.instructions: Standing long jumps, absorb the landing and repeat

exercises.name: Hamstring stretch
exercises.instructions: Leg extended forward, lean torso forward

exercises.name: Standing quad stretch
exercises.instructions: Grab your foot behind you, knee toward the floor

exercises.name: Deep squat hold
exercises.instructions: Hold a deep squat, back straight, elbows against the knees

exercises.name: Deep breathing
exercises.instructions: Inhale 4s through the nose, hold 4s, exhale 6s through the mouth
